description: Take a dev.to article down: it goes back to a draft on the account. dev.to's API cannot delete a post, so a full delete is done in the DEV dashboard, and the reply says so. Call WITHOUT confirm first: nothing changes and you get a sentence naming the article to show the user. Free.

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in, for THIS CALL ONLY: an id or exact name from list_brands, needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

confirm.description: true only once the user agreed to the sentence the first call returned

name: unpublish_devto_article
title: Unpublish a dev.to article
